# HitItOff

> Better Matches, Closer — an AI-powered compatibility dating app.

HitItOff helps adults meet nearby singles using personality quiz matching, AI compatibility scores, mood-based discovery, conversation starters, chemistry tracking, voice bios, date ideas, and safety tools. Launching soon on iOS and Android.
